visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor playroom with a massive ball pit filled with white, pink, and green balls. A man in a dark shirt and a white mask lies submerged in the balls. Two young children, a boy in a striped shirt and a girl with long dark hair, are playing nearby. The boy jumps from a gray padded barrier into the pit. (2) The scene shifts to a hotel lobby area. It features a modern, clean design with a reception desk labeled 'LIYAOU' in gold lettering. Large glass windows look out onto a street with parked cars and a yellow vehicle. A man in a dark jacket and a small girl are seen walking through the lobby space. (3) A series of shots showcase various hotel rooms designed for families. These rooms feature 'tatami' style low wooden platforms with white mattresses. Integrated into the rooms are various play structures: a small indoor slide, a play kitchen set, a small white tent, and colorful wall murals featuring trains, cars, and dinosaurs. The children are shown interacting with these objects—climbing, sliding, and pretending to cook. (4) Close-up shots focus on specific toys including wooden kitchen appliances, magnetic building tiles, and a purple ride-on toy shaped like a creature. The lighting is bright and warm, typical of an indoor hotel setting. (5) In a final sequence, the children are seen jumping on the large beds with white linens. A man sits on a yellow sofa in the background, looking at his smartphone. The video concludes in a dining area where a young boy gives a thumbs up, followed by a young girl with a glass of milk who also smiles and gives a thumbs up.
